repo_notes.content: WriteSpace is a backend built with Express and TypeScript. It uses vertical slicing, with feature modules for authentication, posts, users, interactions, notifications, and AI. PostgreSQL is managed through Drizzle ORM, while Redis and BullMQ support asynchronous processing. Media uploads use Multer with a custom Cloudinary storage engine. When working on the codebase, inspect the existing implementation and preserve established architectural decisions.

pages.title: System Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explain the vertical slicing pattern and dependency inversion. Map the request lifecycle from the Express app.ts through Helmet, CORS, Bot Interceptor, and Rate Limiter down to module controllers and services.

pages.title: Local Development & Docker
pages.purpose: Explain local setup using Node.js 24, npm, and Docker Compose. Cover PostgreSQL and Redis services, environment configuration, npm ci, application startup, and the existing Drizzle commands (db:generate and db:push).

pages.title: Database Schema (Drizzle ORM)
pages.purpose: Document the relational design. Highlight UUID primary keys, soft deletes, composite primary keys, and the relationships between posts, comments, reactions, follows, saves, shares, and notifications.

pages.title: Authentication & Security Model
pages.purpose: Detail the JWT authentication strategy, password hashing, Passport.js OAuth flows, Redis-backed refresh sessions, and security middleware.

pages.title: Async Processing & Queues
pages.purpose: Explain the BullMQ architecture running on Redis. Cover email processing, interaction processing, and asynchronous media cleanup, including the responsibilities of their respective queues and workers.

pages.title: Media Handling & Cloudinary
pages.purpose: Explain the multipart form-data upload process. Multer uses a custom Cloudinary storage engine that streams uploaded files to Cloudinary. Cover returned public IDs, file metadata, and asynchronous cleanup of obsolete Cloudinary assets.

pages.title: Error Handling & Validation
pages.purpose: Explain the global error handler, custom AppError class, standardized HTTP responses, and Zod schemas for request validation.

pages.title: Developer Guide: Adding Features
pages.purpose: Provide the framework for adding a vertical slice module, including Zod schemas, Drizzle tables, repositories, services, controllers, routes, and integration with shared infrastructure.
